dedupe_keys.name: hydrothermal optimal power flow test systems adapted ieee rts 24 bus 118 bus and 300 bus datasets

description: Hydrothermal Optimal Power Flow Test Systems: Adapted IEEE RTS 24-Bus, 118-Bus and 300-bus Datasets is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Amanda Nerger, Leonardo Nepomuceno (Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp)). The datasets presented in this companion document comprise adapted IEEE RTS 24-bus, 118-bus and 300-bus hydrothermal test systems that have been extensively used in the author's research on Hydrothermal Optimal Power Flow (HOPF). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
